conclusion: v2 trained on training_corpus.csv (45k multicultural names) reached 0.9036 standalone on SSA test (vs Hu 2021 char-LSTM SOTA of 0.940). Ensembling with v1 reduced accuracy below v1-alone (0.9379 vs 0.9393). v1 is deployed.  Strict beat of Hu requires a larger training corpus; future work: Wikidata person-dump pretraining (~1M names with gender).
